en_title: Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Says He'd Return to the Doom Series "In a Heartbeat"
cn_title: 《毁灭战士》作曲家愿有条件回归
subtitle: 「毫不犹豫」
opus_summary: Mick Gordon表示，若一系列条件满足，他愿毫不犹豫地回归《毁灭战士》。他未说明具体条件，与开发团队的纠纷可能尚未解决，但仍希望探索为系列构思的创意。

paragraphs.en: Mick Gordon, the legendary Aussie composer who brought a headbang to every headshot in 2016's Doom and its 2020 follow-up Doom Eternal, has told IGN that he's open to the idea of contributing to future instalments in id Software's iconic shooter series. During an interview conducted at this weekend's PAX Australia, Gordon seemed to indicate that his involvement with Doom isn't necessarily done for good, despite the very public falling-out that occurred between the composer and Doom Eternal's development team in the wake of its release.
paragraphs.cn: 澳大利亚传奇作曲家Mick Gordon曾为2016年的《毁灭战士》及其2020年的续作《毁灭战士：永恒》配乐，让玩家每次爆头都忍不住跟着音乐甩头。他向IGN表示，愿意考虑为id Software这款标志性射击游戏系列的后续作品配乐。在本周末的PAX澳大利亚展会上接受采访时，Gordon似乎暗示，他与《毁灭战士》的合作未必就此结束，尽管《毁灭战士：永恒》发售后，他与开发团队的决裂曾闹得人尽皆知。

paragraphs.en: "There are a lot of dominoes that would have to fall in a very specific way for that to occur," said Gordon. "If those dominoes ever fell in that way, I would. Of course. Within a heartbeat."
paragraphs.cn: Gordon说：「要实现这件事，需要很多块多米诺骨牌以非常特定的方式倒下。如果有一天这些骨牌真能这样倒下，我会回归。当然会。毫不犹豫。」

paragraphs.en: Gordon didn't elaborate on exactly what those "dominoes" might be, but it's possible that disputes between the composer and Doom Eternal's executive producer Marty Stratton have yet to be fully resolved. In a lengthy 2022 post on Medium , Gordon accused developer id Software of failing to pay him for half of his work on the Doom Eternal soundtrack, and singled out Stratton as being a recurringly abusive presence throughout his work on the score and the OST. However, it certainly seems as though the experience hasn't dimmed Gordon's love for Doom itself.
paragraphs.cn: Gordon没有具体解释这些「多米诺骨牌」可能指什么，但他与《毁灭战士：永恒》执行制作人Marty Stratton之间的纠纷可能尚未彻底解决。2022年，Gordon在Medium发布长文，指控开发商id Software没有支付他为《毁灭战士：永恒》原声音乐所做的一半工作的报酬。他还点名指责Stratton，称自己在制作游戏配乐和原声专辑的整个过程中反复遭到对方辱骂。不过，这段经历看来确实没有削弱Gordon对《毁灭战士》本身的热爱。

paragraphs.en: "I had a whole list of ideas where I wanted to go with Doom," explained Gordon. "And I'd love to explore that one day, for sure."
paragraphs.cn: Gordon解释道：「关于我想让《毁灭战士》的音乐走向何方，我列过一整份创意清单。我当然希望有朝一日能探索这些想法。」

paragraphs.en: What the future of Doom looks like with or without Gordon's involvement is another story. id Software was one of the many studios heavily impacted by Microsoft's ongoing cuts to its Xbox business, with 136 members of staff at the Doom developer affected by layoffs in July. At the time, lead services programmer Chris Hays was quoted as saying, "It's hard to make a game that is AAA, that's like we've done before, with half the people. And by hard, I mean impossible."
paragraphs.cn: 无论Gordon是否参与，《毁灭战士》的未来会是什么样，则是另一回事。微软持续缩减XBOX业务，许多工作室受到严重冲击，id Software也是其中之一。今年7月，这家《毁灭战士》开发商有136名员工受到裁员影响。当时，服务首席程序员Chris Hays的话被援引报道：「只剩一半的人手，很难做出像我们以前那样的3A游戏。我说很难，其实是指不可能。」

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, Gordon has been keeping busy with a variety of projects. He's contributed the theme music for the final boss fight in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, which will be released on October 14. He's also still actively at work producing the full soundtrack for Defect, the squad-based cyberpunk shooter developed by veterans of Doom and the Call of Duty series. In 2027, he's set to return to Doom at least in a performance sense, as the headliner at the UK's RADAR music festival where he'll be performing the music he composed for Doom and Doom Eternal with a full live band for the first time.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Gordon一直忙于多个项目。他为将于10月14日发售的《战锤40K：Boltgun 2》创作了最终Boss战的主题音乐。他也仍在积极制作《Defect》的完整原声音乐。这款小队制赛博朋克射击游戏由曾参与《毁灭战士》和《使命召唤》系列的资深开发者打造。2027年，他至少将在演出层面回归《毁灭战士》：他将作为英国RADAR音乐节的领衔嘉宾，首次与完整的现场乐队一起，演奏自己为《毁灭战士》和《毁灭战士：永恒》创作的音乐。
